test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

The project is being evaluated by the panel.

options.text: The panel was evaluating the project.
The panel has evaluated the project.
The panel is evaluating the project.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in the **Present Continuous Passive** voice ("is being evaluated").
 
• To convert it to the **active voice**, the object of the passive sentence ("the panel") becomes the subject of the active sentence.
 
• The verb structure must change from *is/am/are + being + V3* to **is/am/are + V1+ing** to maintain the continuous tense.
 
• Therefore, "is being evaluated" becomes "**is evaluating**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The panel **is evaluating** the project."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "The panel was evaluating the project."** – This is in the Past Continuous tense, which changes the original meaning.
 
• **Option 2: "The panel has evaluated the project."** – This is in the Present Perfect tense, indicating a completed action.
 
• **Option 4: "The panel evaluates the project."** – This is in the Simple Present tense, which indicates a general fact or habit rather than an ongoing action.
